brief: Francis Xavier was one of the most effective and devoted missionaries who ever lived. He was born in 1506 in Spain, and in 1534 became one of the seven original Jesuits. In 1541 he went to the East Indies to preach the gospel and establish the church. He converted many in the eleven years in which he was actively evangelising in India, Ceylon, Malacca, Malaya, and especially Japan. He died on board ship on his way to China in December 1552.
